stories.summary: Add User Authentication and Profile Management to Mobile App

details.user_story: As a user, I want to create an account and log in to the DiamondMind app so that my swing analysis history is saved and accessible across sessions and devices.
details.context: DM-10 implemented the backend database with users, swings, and analysis_results tables. The mobile app currently operates anonymously without user accounts. We need to add authentication UI (login/signup screens), persist user sessions, and associate all swing uploads with the logged-in user. This enables features like viewing swing history, tracking progress over time, and multi-device access.
acceptance_criteria: User can create a new account with email and username
User can log in with existing credentials
User session persists across app restarts (AsyncStorage)
All swing uploads are automatically associated with logged-in user (user_id sent to backend)
User can view their swing history (list of past swings)
User can tap a swing to view its analysis results
App shows 'Sign Up / Log In' screen on first launch
App shows main upload screen after successful login
Graceful error handling for network failures and invalid credentials
technical_details: Mobile App - New Screens:
- LoginScreen.js: Email/username input, login button, 'Create Account' link
- SignupScreen.js: Email, username inputs, signup button, 'Already have account?' link
- ProfileScreen.js: Display username, email, logout button, swing history list
- SwingHistoryScreen.js: List of user's swings with thumbnails and dates
- SwingDetailScreen.js: Display full analysis for a selected swing
Mobile App - Navigation:
- Add React Navigation (if not already present)
- Stack Navigator: Login → Signup → Main App (Upload/Profile tabs)
- Tab Navigator: Upload tab, Profile tab
- Conditional rendering: Show auth screens if not logged in, main app if logged in
Mobile App - State Management:
- Add user context (UserContext.js) to store current user data
- Store user session in AsyncStorage (key: 'user_session')
- Load user session on app startup
- Clear session on logout
Mobile App - API Integration:
- Create AuthService.js:
- signup(email, username) → POST /api/users
- login(email) → GET /api/users (search by email, or add login endpoint)
- getCurrentUser() → returns user from AsyncStorage
- logout() → clears AsyncStorage
- Update UploadService.js:
- Pass user_id parameter to /api/videos/upload
- Get user_id from UserContext
- Create SwingService.js:
- getUserSwings(user_id) → GET /api/users/{user_id}/swings
- getSwingAnalysis(swing_id) → GET /api/swings/{swing_id}/analysis
Backend Changes (if needed):
- Add GET /api/users?email={email} endpoint for login (search by email)
- Or add POST /api/auth/login endpoint with email validation
- Ensure /api/videos/upload accepts user_id parameter (already implemented)
UI/UX Design:
- Clean, minimal login/signup forms
- Use existing app color scheme (gold accents, dark theme)
- Show loading spinner during API calls
- Display friendly error messages (e.g., 'Email already exists', 'User not found')
- Swing history: Card-based list with video thumbnail, date, score (if available)
- Pull-to-refresh on swing history
Data Flow:
1. User signs up → POST /api/users → Store user in AsyncStorage → Navigate to main app
2. User logs in → GET /api/users?email={email} → Store user in AsyncStorage → Navigate to main app
3. User uploads swing → Include user_id in upload request → Backend saves to database
4. User views history → GET /api/users/{user_id}/swings → Display list
5. User taps swing → GET /api/swings/{swing_id}/analysis → Display analysis with skeleton overlay
edge_cases: Duplicate Email/Username: Backend returns 400 error, show 'Email already exists' message
Invalid Login: User not found, show 'No account found with this email' message
Network Failure During Signup/Login: Show 'Unable to connect' message, allow retry
Session Expiry: Currently no session expiry (future: add JWT tokens with expiration)
Offline Mode: User can view cached swing history but cannot upload or fetch new data
Empty Swing History: Show empty state with 'Upload your first swing!' message
Logout During Upload: Cancel upload, clear session, return to login screen
Backend Cold Start: Show loading spinner, handle timeout gracefully
User Deletes Account: Future feature - need DELETE /api/users/{user_id} endpoint
Password Reset: Future feature - currently no password (email-based login only)
